definitions.gloss: even if, even though, no matter
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce a hypothetical or concessive condition, emphasizing that the outcome won't change regardless of the condition.

examples.japanese: たとえ{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}っても、{行|い}きます。
examples.english: Even if it rains, I will go.

examples.japanese: たとえ{失敗|しっぱい}しても、{諦|あきら}めない。
examples.english: Even if I fail, I won't give up.

examples.japanese: たとえ{時間|じかん}がかかっても、やり{遂|と}げる。
examples.english: No matter how long it takes, I will accomplish it.

examples.japanese: たとえ{遠|とお}くても、{会|あ}いに{行|い}く。
examples.english: Even if it's far, I'll go to see you.

examples.japanese: たとえ{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}に{反対|はんたい}されても、{自分|じぶん}の{夢|ゆめ}を{追|お}いかけたい。
examples.english: Even if the people around me are against it, I want to pursue my dream.

notes:
GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
- たとえ〜ても: Even if ~ (with te-form + も)
- たとえ〜でも: Even if ~ (with noun/na-adjective + でも)
- たとえ〜としても: Even assuming that ~

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- たとえ: Even if (emphasizes hypothetical)
- もし: If (neutral conditional)
- {仮|かり}に: Supposing, even if (more formal)

NOTE: たとえ is typically paired with 〜ても/〜でも to form the complete pattern. Using たとえ emphasizes the speaker's determination or that the condition doesn't matter.
